about: Stats other accounts posted that the user sent (11/14 and 11/15), and the morning our detectors should have had them. src/anticipate/flagcheck.js runs them every build; docs/data/flag-checks.json has the results. Checks with a past `season` are replayed from the results history and the players' logs; `replayable: false` ones need data we don't keep for past seasons.
